answer: Because the nectar count is verified against the yarrow text itself, the anchor audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 128 aliases hence means producing 128 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
